name: Fertö / Neusiedlersee Cultural Landscape
description: Straddling the Austria–Hungary border, this landscape surrounds Neusiedler See, a broad, shallow steppe lake fringed with reed beds. People have lived and traded here for around eight thousand years, and the mix of cultures shaped its farmland, wetlands and villages. Today you can wander among distinctive rural houses in the lakeside settlements and visit several grand 18th- and 19th-century palaces.
